asrHints: Opsmira, nginx, SSH, audit log, read-only, self-host, open source
base: Voice affect: calm, assured and warm, like a senior engineer explaining something to a colleague who has very little time. Tone: plain and concrete, with a slight smile, never salesy. Pacing: steady and unhurried but not slow, a natural conversational rhythm, with brief pauses at commas and between short phrases. Emphasis: lightly stress the key word of each phrase, nothing dramatic. Delivery: no announcer or ad-read energy, no rising selling intonation, end each sentence with a natural settled fall. Keep the volume even and the diction clear.

lines.text: Something's wrong with the server.
lines.style: This line: quiet and a little weary, matter-of-fact, the worst moment of the day.

lines.text: And the fix is a command you only half remember.
lines.style: This line: quiet, dry and a little wry.

lines.text: There's a calmer way.
lines.style: This line: a softer, warmer tone, like a relieved exhale, slightly brighter than before.

lines.text: Opsmira. Ask in plain words.
lines.style: This line: warm and inviting, simple and clear, a short pause after the name.

lines.text: It looks, with read-only commands that run on their own.
And it shows you what it found. Live.
Then it proposes the fix: what it does, how risky it is, the exact command.
Nothing changes until you approve.
lines.style: Firm and reassuring, with a little weight on the word approve.

lines.text: Every action goes in the audit log.
Connect any server with one command.
The agent dials out.
No SSH keys. No open ports.
lines.style: Two short flat statements with a clear beat between them.

lines.text: Ask it to keep watch.
Check the disks every morning.
Tell me if the nginx config changes.
Look into it if memory passes ninety percent.
It wakes up on its own, investigates, and leaves you a report.
If a change is needed, it waits for you.
Prefer to type it yourself? Start with an exclamation mark.
lines.style: Light and friendly, a small smile in the voice on the second sentence.

lines.text: It runs your command, and the agent reads the result.
Opsmira is open source.
Self-host it in one command.
Bring any model.
Your servers, your keys.
Opsmira. Your server, in plain words.
lines.style: Slow, warm and settled, quiet confidence, a little space after the name.
